descriptions.Una diosa loba restaura el color de Japó:
A wolf goddess restores Japan's color with a celestial brush.

Amaterasu awakens when a shadow covers the land and the villages lose their color. With the Celestial Brush you stop time and paint on the screen: a circle makes the sun rise, a line cuts down enemies and a stroke on a dead tree makes it bloom.

The journey crosses plains, forests and towns inspired by woodblock prints, with dungeons, fights and dozens of characters asking for help. Each new brush technique opens paths in places you already visited.

Its watercolor-and-ink style is still one of the most recognizable of its generation.
